description: v2.1.0 section 9.3, PROJECT — the serialized result of projecting a named export out of a structured definition (e.g. PROJECT(injury, result) -> injury_result). PROJECT itself is a mechanical structural-reuse utility, not a legal constructor, but section 22 lists ExportedComponentDef as its own Definition Layer object, so the projection result is recorded explicitly here rather than left implicit — this preserves provenance (section 18) back to the offense and export key it came from.

source_offense.description: The OffenseDef (or DerivedOffenseDef) id this was projected from.

export_key.description: The key under the source offense's 'exports' map, e.g. 'result'. Not restricted to fixed_slot_name because an offense may export a named sub-expression rather than a whole slot.

resolved_ref.description: The concrete predicate/expression id this export resolves to at the source offense. section 7's example: offense injury { exports { result: injury_result } } -> resolved_ref is 'injury_result'.
